question: A person travels 10 km to the north, then 6 km to the east, and finally 2 km to the south. What is the straight-line distance between his final position and the starting point?
solution:
According to the given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9cbfb7e5643fe991a863942f7224565eff27d1a7b12da659fc93c4e26cdedc6.png] 

The straight-line distance between his final position and the starting point = {sqrt{(10-2)²+6²} } = {sqrt{8²+6²} } = {sqrt{64 + 36} } = {sqrt{(100} } = 10 km

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 2**”.
